chain.title: An Ancient Tomb
chain.desc: The mod's whole content: one rebuilt desert temple with TEN chest tables and a Pharaoh at the bottom. Clearing him lifts the mining fatigue the temple applies; tomb_pharaoh pays diamonds, an enchanted golden apple and diamond horse armour.

notes: SHORT ON PURPOSE - ONE STRUCTURE, NO ITEMS, so one entry and no padding. THE MOD ID IS betterdeserttemples, NOT yungsbetterdeserttemples (META-INF/mods.toml: modId betterdeserttemples, version 1.20-Forge-3.0.3, minecraft [1.20,1.21), forge [46.0.2,), no fabric.mod.json). assets/betterdeserttemples/ has three lang files and NOTHING else - no models/item, no blockstates, no item./block. keys - so item_count_in_jar is 0 and collections is empty. CONTENT: one structure, data/betterdeserttemples/worldgen/structure/desert_temple.json, type yungsapi:yung_jigsaw, biomes minecraft:desert plus optional #forge:is_desert, #c:desert and terralith desert biomes, step surface_structures, with spawn overrides for husk, cat and rabbit. It is the loot-densest single structure in the whole YUNG family: the nbt walk resolved ALL TEN of its chest tables directly out of the raw NBT across 187 pieces - chests/food_storage, lab, library, pharaoh_hidden, pot, statue, storage, tomb, tomb_pharaoh and wardrobe. Contents read from the json: tomb_pharaoh lists diamond, enchanted_golden_apple, diamond_horse_armor and golden_sword; storage lists diamond/golden/iron horse armour and oxidized and weathered copper; food_storage lists an enchanted_golden_apple; lab lists potions, fermented_spider_eye and a rabbit_foot. THE PHARAOH IS NOT A CUSTOM MOB AND GETS NO kill: ENTRY. data/betterdeserttemples/advancements/temple_clear.json ('Eternal Slumber - Slay the Pharaoh and free the Temple from his curse') triggers on minecraft:player_killed_entity where the predicate is type minecraft:husk, located inside betterdeserttemples:desert_temple, wearing a specific textured player head. There is no entity.betterdeserttemples.* lang key anywhere in the jar, so kill:minecraft:husk would be far too broad to be honest and is not used; the fight is described in prose instead. The mining fatigue claim is from the mod's own config strings, which name applyMiningFatigue as 'whether or not mining fatigue is applied to players in the temple if it has not yet been cleared'. The mod also ships a disableVanillaPyramids option, so in a pack that enables it this structure REPLACES the vanilla pyramid rather than joining it. NOTE THE LOADER THRESHOLD: _load_researched_chains keeps curated chains of 4+ rows, so this one-row file will be skipped by that path; the generator's structure_quests() still picks the id up from the jar scan, and this file is the loot record behind it. ID FORM: 'structure:' + fully namespaced. Requires yungsapi.
